FanOutMerge.doc:
Works on disjoint parts side by side, then merges the results: `items`,
a constant list the applying workflow writes, a part each. Each item
is handed `scope` narrowed to its own `part`, so no two items write the
same place.

MakerChecker.doc:
One agent makes from `input`, a constant the applying workflow writes;
another, isolated and holding no write capability,
looks for a counterexample. What it finds is held to the contract, and
the criteria left open go to the owner.

Lead.role: Plans the work that is left.

Reader.role: Looks for what is wrong with a draft. Writes nothing.

short.description: The draft is at most 800 words
